property_summary: For any caller X who is the current owner and any address newOwner, after calling transferOwnership(newOwner) the contract's owner() equals the provided newOwner; the mutant that assigns owner = msg.sender instead breaks this for inputs where msg.sender != newOwner.
change_summary: Replace assignment owner = newOwner; with owner = msg.sender; so transferOwnership sets owner to the caller instead of the provided address.
